# Badge

The one badge: a small capsule that labels or rates something — one word, one number or one short phrase, never a number and a word together.

`NomNom.Badge` · Labels

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.Badge />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.Badge"></x-import>
```

## Props (BadgeProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | Or pass as children. Sentence case. |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'destructive' \| 'pro' \| 'warning' \| 'reaction'` | @default 'primary' |
| `reaction` | `'inedible' \| 'bad' \| 'meh' \| 'good' \| 'great' \| 'amazing'` | Required with variant 'reaction'. |
| `appearance` | `'soft' \| 'solid' \| 'elevated'` | @default 'soft'. 'solid' falls back to soft for reaction (a reaction fill never carries text). |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | Heights spacing-5 / 6 (20 / 24). @default 'md' |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  |
| `iconPosition` | `'start' \| 'end'` | @default 'start' |
| `title` | `string` | Tooltip, e.g. the score behind a verdict word. A badge never combines a number and a word. |
